name: Ui_MessageWindow_Close
summary: Plain message-window close: closes the cutscene, fires cutscene commands 1 and 2, and releases the pager widgets via 0x00625FD8.
evidence: Body is the common close sequence (Cutscene_Close, Event_OnCutSceneCommand 1/2, func_00625FD8) with no extra sub-widget call, so the 'WithPage' suffix is unsupported; no callers to confirm.

name: Ui_MessageWindow_CloseWithCursor

evidence: Body contains the common close sequence plus the cursor-state clear and self+0x8C return; the +0xC object is still unnamed and there are no callers.

name: Ui_MessageWindow_CloseWithNameTag

name: SpriteActor_DispatchAction
summary: Per-frame dispatch: if the current field actor's state is not 0x0D and the field UI mode is 5, plays action sequence 0x0D for the rectangle built from self+0x298; otherwise queues gadget command 0x0C with the sprite id.
evidence: Named callees Actor_TryPlayActionSeq0D, Field_Gadget_AddAndTriggerCommand and Actor2D_ReRegisterObject make the two-way choice explicit; the sprite class is inferred from layout and rectangle fields.

name: Actor_UpdateAnimationState
summary: Refreshes the actor's model record, then dispatches on flags +0x29B/+0x29D: if +0x29D is set it calls vtable+0x40 with state 4, otherwise it plays the shared default animation and freezes the animator on its last frame.
evidence: Callees Actor_ApplyModelRecordFast, Anim_PlayByIdForActor, Field_SceneObject_SetAnimatorLastFrame; two-flag state dispatch on actor+0x29B/+0x29D; no caller or vtable word fixes the class, so the Actor2D prefix is dropped.

name: Actor_PlayDefaultAnimation

evidence: Only callees are Actor_ApplyModelRecordFast and func_002D1258(animator, g_actorDefaultAnimName, 0); no caller or vtable word, so the sprite/class label is not proven.

name: maybe_Field_Object_ApplyModelOffset
summary: Refreshes the object's model record and adds the model record's signed fixed-point +0x10 value to the object's position field, the bobbing offset used by floating field props.
evidence: Callee Actor_ApplyModelRecordFast and callers Field2D_MapChip_ResetWalkTrigger / Field2D_Scene_BuildFromMapData fix the field scene; the fixed-point conversion is damaged (in_fpscr) and 'Gadget' is inferred, so keep a generic Field_Object name.

name: Field_Actor_ApplyAnimRecord
summary: Refreshes the model record, stores the resolved animation id (0x0029E488) in the animator at +0xB8 as +0x128, sets animator state byte +0x129 = 5 and re-applies the node position.
evidence: Callees Actor_ApplyModelRecordFast, Anim_Clip_Start, Field_SceneObject_ClearPartFlag; twin 0x005AFEE0 is the same code without the state byte and position; no caller or vtable word fixes the class.

name: maybe_Actor_ApplyAnimRecordOnly
summary: Refreshes the model record and writes the resolved animation id (0x0029E488) into the animator's +0x128; the reduced variant of 0x005AF350 without the state byte or position update.

name: GameWork_AreAllFiveSlotsOccupied
summary: Returns 1 only when all five entries in the game work's parallel arrays at +0x2A198 (object pointer) and +0x2A26C (flag byte), stride 0x10, are occupied; breaks at the first free entry and returns 0. Used by damage/heal/MP popups and recipe/Uma window code.
evidence: Loop breaks on flag 0 or null pointer and only reaches return 1 after the fifth entry; 11 callers include Battle_Popup_PrepareHealNumberPanes, Ui_DamagePopup_SetNumber, Ui_RecipeInfo_IsUnlocked, Ui_UmaWindow_ResetToPage4Or5. What the five slots represent is still unknown.
